pieces.doc: Button that toggles the dropdown menu when clicked, opens via ArrowDown (focus first item) or ArrowUp (focus last item).

Headless implementation of the [WAI-ARIA Menu Button pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/menu-button/). Apply on a wrapper that contains the trigger and the `@if`-mounted `[forMenuContent]`. The directive owns open state, ids, and the registries that wire trigger / content / items together.

inputs.name: side
inputs.doc: Side the menu is anchored to. Defaults to `'bottom'`. Pair with `align` for the full positioning API.

inputs.name: align
inputs.doc: Alignment along the chosen `side`. Defaults to `'start'`.

inputs.name: sideOffset
inputs.doc: Gap (px) between trigger and menu along the main axis. Default `4`. Mirrors Radix's `sideOffset`. The default is read from `provideForDropdownMenuDefaults` for the surrounding scope.

inputs.name: alignOffset
inputs.doc: Gap (px) along the cross axis. Default `0`.

inputs.name: avoidCollisions
inputs.doc: When `true` (default), `flip` and `shift` keep the menu inside the viewport.

inputs.name: collisionPadding
inputs.doc: Padding (px) applied uniformly to flip / shift / size. Default `8`. The default is read from `provideForDropdownMenuDefaults` for the surrounding scope.

inputs.name: hideWhenDetached
inputs.doc: When `true`, sets `data-detached=""` while the trigger is scrolled off-screen.

inputs.name: dir
inputs.doc: Writing direction. Drives ArrowLeft / ArrowRight semantics on submenu triggers and items underneath this menu (in RTL, ArrowLeft opens a submenu and ArrowRight closes it back). Default `'ltr'`.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.doc: When true, trigger interaction is ignored and any open menu stays open until the consumer flips `open` themselves. The trigger reflects `data-disabled`; the items keep their per-item disabled semantics.

inputs.name: dismissible
inputs.doc: When true (default), Escape, pointer-down outside, and focus outside close the menu.

inputs.name: returnFocus
inputs.doc: When true (default), focus returns to the trigger on close.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.doc: Manual `aria-label` on `[forMenuContent]`. Use when the trigger isn't a meaningful name.

outputs.name: autoFocusOnOpen
outputs.doc: Fires just before the menu sends focus to its first / last enabled item on mount. Call `preventDefault()` on the emitted veto to skip the imperative focus move — useful when opening a menu from an input you want to keep focused.

outputs.name: autoFocusOnClose
outputs.doc: Fires just before focus returns to the trigger on unmount. Call `preventDefault()` on the veto to suppress the return-focus.

models.name: open
models.doc: Two-way bindable. Whether the menu is currently shown. The `model()` change emitter (`(openChange)`) fires only on internal transitions (trigger toggle, Escape, outside dismissal, item selection), never on consumer writes via `[(open)]`.
